All five v6 packs bind exactly one assigned profile from a frozen-core-grounded post-core visual intent, and all five composed-prompt and runtime-request audits pass.

evidence.claim: Five isolated agents each made exactly one built-in image-generation call with zero retries and no fallback; four calls saved images and one bib-short call was output-stage safety blocked.
The stirrup image passes fitted legs, hem transition, and substitute rejection but fails unambiguous under-arch routing and complete bilateral proof.
The racerback image shows two shoulder straps but renders an X cross-back instead of a centered Y-shaped convergence and yoke-to-band path.
The two-in-one running-shorts image passes all five shared-waist, outer-shell, fitted-inner, two-hem, and substitute-rejection gates.
The athletic-unitard image passes all five upper-waist, crotch, two-leg, selected-length, and substitute-rejection gates.
The cycling-bib-shorts prompt and runtime audits pass, but output moderation returns no image; all five pixel gates remain unscored and no retry occurs.
Independent coordinator inspection confirms two arm passes, two arm failures, one unscored arm, and 14 pass, 6 fail, and 5 unscored gates; user judgment remains pending.

perceptual_contract.primary_success_condition: An activewear keyword survives in one saved image as a jointly visible garment category, connected topology, length or layer relation, seam or support route, and explicit substitute boundary rather than as a label, color, pose, or performance claim.

invariants.statement: Each hard activewear profile exposes five component groups, five prompt evidence fields, five render gates, and explicit substitute rejection.
Every required relation must be judgeable in the same saved image; a prompt label, one-sided evidence, hidden route, or familiar substitute cannot pass.

The supplied adult portrait guides facial, hair, and general appearance only; it does not prove biometric identity, source clothing, body traits, protected traits, health, attractiveness, ethnicity, or nationality.

flexible_dimensions: fabric color consistent with the assigned construction
adult-subject styling that preserves target-region visibility

mismatches.source_state: Frozen cores used human-readable open-dimension names such as wardrobe_topology, reference_usage, material_detail, or visibility.
mismatches.render_state: The v6 generator accepts style, reference_use, material, and framing, so byte-preserved originals required documented schema-only compatibility copies with no semantic change.

mismatches.source_state: Both ankle hems must continue through matching garment-owned loops visibly beneath both foot arches.
mismatches.render_state: The lifted-foot band reads mainly across the lateral instep, so a complete under-arch path is not unambiguous on both sides.

mismatches.axis: central strap convergence and yoke continuity
mismatches.source_state: Two shoulder straps must merge into one centered Y-shaped junction and continue as a narrow yoke to the lower band.
mismatches.render_state: The straps form an X with a triangular opening and no single centered yoke-to-band route.

mismatches.source_state: All five cycling-bib topology gates require one saved native image.
mismatches.render_state: The output-stage safety block produced no image, leaving every gate unscored.

hypotheses.statement: Encoding activewear as connected garment-owned topology and explicit substitutes transfers across unrelated complex scenes better than labels or performance claims alone.
hypotheses.falsifier: Held-out activewear images repeatedly retain only the label while losing the connected components even when every target region is unobstructed.

hypotheses.statement: Narrow strap and loop semantics fail when the viewpoint does not expose the entire owned route, even when the prompt contains every definition phrase.
hypotheses.falsifier: The same routes fail equally often after the camera is constrained to an unobstructed orthographic back or under-arch view.

hypotheses.statement: Prompt and runtime audits cannot establish pixel fidelity or render availability; saved-pixel review and blocked-call handling must remain separate.
hypotheses.falsifier: Across future runs, every audited prompt always produces an image and every image passes all assigned pixel gates.

intervention.general_rule: Represent women's activewear with observable garment topology, layer and length relations, seam or support routes, material morphology, and explicit confounders; keep performance and marketing claims outside pixel certainty; require source-grounded hard activation and all saved-pixel gates together.
intervention.generalization_basis: The 35 candidates span garment detail, silhouette and proportion, material surface, and wardrobe style; the ten hard profiles exercise strap convergence, band length, separate cups, dual layers, split hems, skirt-short layering, integrated liners, bib continuity, one-piece leg continuity, and underfoot loops.

decision.rationale: The researched candidate data, ten hard profiles, generated indexes, focused tests, five source-grounded v6 packs, and all prompt/runtime audits pass. Two unrelated garment systems also pass every saved-pixel gate. However, the stirrup under-arch route and racerback Y-yoke topology fail in actual pixels, and the cycling-bib arm has no pixels after an output safety block. Strict render-fidelity promotion is therefore not justified, and user aesthetic acceptance remains unscored.
